title: 2.1.17 Predict, Then Run
description: Log four comparison expressions, including at least one ===, and observe the results. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: practice for comparison operators used throughout book 2.1

steps.title: Write four comparisons
steps.instructions: Write four console.log statements, each printing the result of a comparison expression. At least one comparison must use === (strict equality).

steps.title: Predict the output
steps.instructions: Before you run the code, write a comment above each console.log guessing whether it will print true or false. Then run the code and see how you did.

requirements.title: strict equality used
requirements.description: Code contains at least one === comparison

requirements.title: logs a comparison expression
requirements.description: At least one console.log directly prints the result of a comparison (e.g. console.log(5 > 3)), not just a plain value

requirements.title: four comparisons logged
requirements.description: At least four separate console.log calls each print the result of a comparison
